title: Chances of an AI catastrophe, by who answered and what they were asked
source: AI Impacts (2024 survey, published September 2026), the Forecasting Research Institute (LEAP wave 9, May–June 2026, and its 2022 tournament), Rethink Priorities (June 2023), the statements linked from each thought leader’s profile and Doom or Bloom’s aggregates as of October 3, 2026. The outcomes and time frames differ, so read each number with its question.

rows.label: Authors at six top AI venues
rows.wording: What probability do you put on future AI advances causing human extinction or similarly permanent and severe disempowerment of the human species?
rows.detail: Median of the 744 asked this way, AI Impacts, December 2024

rows.label: Experts on the LEAP panel
rows.wording: A catastrophic event caused primarily by artificial intelligence systems in which more than 10% of the people alive at the start of a five-year period die by the end of that period
rows.detail: Chance by 2100, median of 192 experts, May–June 2026

rows.label: Superforecasters on the LEAP panel
rows.detail: The same question, median of 53 superforecasters

rows.label: AI experts in the 2022 forecasting tournament
rows.wording: reduction of the global population to less than 5,000
rows.detail: The tournament’s definition of extinction; chance AI causes it by 2100, median of its AI domain experts, June–October 2022

rows.label: Superforecasters in the same tournament
rows.detail: The same question, median of 88 superforecasters

rows.label: US adults on the LEAP panel
rows.detail: LEAP’s catastrophe question, by 2100, median of 612 adults reweighted to the US population, May–June 2026

rows.label: US adults, Rethink Priorities
rows.wording: percentage likelihood that AI would cause human extinction by the year 2100
rows.detail: Median of 2,407 adults recruited online and modeled to the US population, June 2023
